name: Dr. Maya Rivera
headline: PhD physics. Builds intuition from first principles.
bio: Hi, I'm Maya. I've taught physics and calculus for nine years — to high schoolers, undergrads, and the occasional career switcher. Sessions are paced to your goals: AP/IB exam crunch, conceptual remediation, or research-style problem solving. I'll send you a small worked-example pack after each session so the ideas stick.

name: Adaeze Okafor
headline: Bilingual writing coach for IELTS, TOEFL & college essays.
bio: Bilingual writing coach with a decade of experience preparing students for IELTS, TOEFL, and the Common App. I focus on argument architecture and voice, not formulas.

name: Kenji Tanaka
headline: Software engineer turned tutor — Python, algorithms, ML.
bio: Ex-Google engineer who switched to teaching. I work best with motivated learners aiming for FAANG interview prep, AP CS A, or first ML projects.

name: Ana Bauer
headline: Spanish & Portuguese tutor — conversational and immersive.
bio: Native Brazilian-Portuguese speaker, fluent Spanish. Sessions run in the target language from minute one — comfortable, paced, and grammar-light.

name: Eli Thoma
headline: Economics & data — clear graphs, sharper intuition.
bio: Economist and data analyst. I teach AP Macro/Micro and intro statistics with hand-drawn graphs and Excel walkthroughs.

name: Sofia Ramirez
headline: Cellist & music theory — Royal Conservatory L8 prep.
bio: Professional cellist with conservatory teaching credentials. I prepare students for RCM L1–10 exams and also coach hobbyists who want a structured music-theory foundation.
